_comment: Issue number = position in this list (1-based). Title on GitHub is '<NN> · <title>'. Resources with verified=false were named from memory, not checked against a source.

issues.title: Back-of-the-envelope estimation
issues.goal: Be able to size a system (QPS, storage, bandwidth) in a few minutes with numbers you can defend.
cover: Latency numbers every programmer should know

resources.text: system-design-primer: [Powers of two table](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#powers-of-two-table), [Latency numbers every programmer should know](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#latency-numbers-every-programmer-should-know)
Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Back-of-the-envelope Estimation" chapter

issues.title: Load balancing
issues.goal: Understand how traffic is spread across servers and what each balancing choice costs.

resources.text: system-design-primer: [Load balancer](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#load-balancer), [Layer 4 load balancing](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#layer-4-load-balancing), [Layer 7 load balancing](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#layer-7-load-balancing)

issues.title: Caching strategies
issues.goal: Know which caching pattern fits which read/write workload and how caches fail.

resources.text: system-design-primer: [Cache](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#cache), [When to update the cache](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#when-to-update-the-cache)

issues.title: Database replication
issues.goal: Understand the replication topologies and the consistency anomalies each one introduces.

resources.text: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "Replication" chapter
system-design-primer: [Replication](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#replication)

issues.title: Sharding & partitioning
issues.goal: Know how to split data across nodes and how partitioning choices create or avoid hotspots.

resources.text: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "Partitioning" chapter
system-design-primer: [Sharding](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#sharding)

issues.title: Consistent hashing
issues.goal: Understand why consistent hashing minimizes data movement when nodes join or leave.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design Consistent Hashing" chapter
*Dynamo: Amazon's Highly Available Key-value Store* (SOSP 2007), partitioning section

issues.title: CAP, PACELC & consistency models
issues.goal: Be precise about what consistency guarantees mean and what they cost in availability and latency.
cover: Strong vs eventual vs causal consistency

resources.text: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "Consistency and Consensus" chapter
system-design-primer: [CAP theorem](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#cap-theorem), [Consistency patterns](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#consistency-patterns)

issues.title: Message queues & pub/sub
issues.goal: Understand queue vs log semantics and the delivery guarantees each can and can't give.

resources.text: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "Stream Processing" chapter
system-design-primer: [Message queues](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#message-queues), [Back pressure](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#back-pressure)

issues.title: Idempotency & retries
issues.goal: Know how to make operations safe to retry and why exactly-once is built, not given.

resources.text: Stripe blog: [Designing robust and predictable APIs with idempotency](https://stripe.com/blog/idempotency)
Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "Stream Processing" chapter

issues.title: Rate limiting
issues.goal: Know the rate limiting algorithms, then design a distributed rate limiter.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design A Rate Limiter" chapter

issues.title: API design
issues.goal: Be able to choose an API style and design pagination, versioning, and errors deliberately.

resources.text: system-design-primer: [Representational state transfer (REST)](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#representational-state-transfer-rest), [Remote procedure call (RPC)](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#remote-procedure-call-rpc)
Google Cloud API Design Guide

issues.title: Event-driven architecture, CQRS & event sourcing
issues.goal: Understand when events, CQRS, and event sourcing help and when they add pain for no gain.

resources.text: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "Stream Processing" chapter
Martin Fowler: "Event Sourcing" and "CQRS" articles

issues.title: Distributed transactions
issues.goal: Know how to keep data consistent across services without a single database transaction.

resources.text: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "Transactions", "Consistency and Consensus" chapters
Chris Richardson, microservices.io: Saga and Transactional Outbox patterns

issues.title: Resilience patterns
issues.goal: Know the patterns that stop one slow or failing dependency from taking down the system.

resources.text: Amazon Builders' Library: [Timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter](https://aws.amazon.com/builders-library/timeouts-retries-and-backoff-with-jitter/)
Michael Nygard, *Release It!*

issues.title: Consensus & leader election
issues.goal: Understand how a cluster agrees on a leader and what goes wrong when it doesn't.

resources.text: [The Raft Consensus Algorithm](https://raft.github.io/) (paper and visualization)
Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "The Trouble with Distributed Systems", "Consistency and Consensus" chapters

issues.title: Probabilistic data structures
issues.goal: Know what Bloom filters, HyperLogLog, and count-min sketch trade away and where each shows up.
cover: Where each shows up in real systems

resources.text: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "Storage and Retrieval" chapter (Bloom filters in LSM trees)
Redis documentation: Bloom filter and HyperLogLog data types

issues.title: Storage engines & indexing
issues.goal: Understand how B-trees and LSM trees store data and why that shapes read/write performance.

resources.text: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "Storage and Retrieval" chapter

issues.title: URL shortener
issues.goal: Design a URL shortener that serves very high read traffic with low latency.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design A Url Shortener" chapter
system-design-primer: [Design Pastebin.com (or Bit.ly)](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer/blob/master/solutions/system_design/pastebin/README.md)

issues.title: Unique ID generator
issues.goal: Design a distributed ID generator and justify its ordering and uniqueness guarantees.
cover: UUID vs DB sequence vs Snowflake

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design A Unique Id Generator In Distributed Systems" chapter
Twitter engineering blog: "Announcing Snowflake" (2010)

issues.title: Distributed key-value store
issues.goal: Design a Dynamo-style key-value store and explain every availability/consistency knob.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design A Key-value Store" chapter
*Dynamo: Amazon's Highly Available Key-value Store* (SOSP 2007)

issues.title: Notification system
issues.goal: Design a notification system that fans out across channels reliably without spamming users.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design A Notification System" chapter

issues.title: Chat system (WhatsApp-like)
issues.goal: Design a 1:1 and group chat system with real-time delivery and offline sync.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design A Chat System" chapter

issues.title: News feed (Twitter/Instagram)
issues.goal: Design a news feed and choose a fan-out strategy that survives celebrity accounts.
cover: Fan-out on write vs fan-out on read

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design A News Feed System" chapter
system-design-primer: [Design the Twitter timeline and search](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer/blob/master/solutions/system_design/twitter/README.md)

issues.title: Web crawler
issues.goal: Design a polite, distributed web crawler that avoids duplicate work.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design A Web Crawler" chapter
system-design-primer: [Design a web crawler](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer/blob/master/solutions/system_design/web_crawler/README.md)

issues.title: Search autocomplete / typeahead
issues.goal: Design a typeahead service that returns top suggestions per prefix in milliseconds.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design A Search Autocomplete System" chapter

issues.title: Distributed job scheduler
issues.goal: Design a scheduler that runs cron-style jobs at scale without missing or duplicating runs.

resources.text: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (1st ed.): "The Trouble with Distributed Systems", "Consistency and Consensus" chapters (leader election, fencing)
system-design-primer: [Asynchronism](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer#asynchronism)

issues.title: Video streaming platform (YouTube/Netflix)
issues.goal: Design the upload-to-playback path of a video platform at global scale.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide*: "Design Youtube" chapter
Netflix Technology Blog

issues.title: Proximity service / ride-sharing (Yelp/Uber)
issues.goal: Design location search and matching that handles constant location updates.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide* Vol. 2: "Proximity Service" chapter
Uber Engineering blog: H3 hexagonal spatial index

issues.title: Payment system
issues.goal: Design a payment system where money moves exactly once and every cent can be reconciled.

resources.text: Alex Xu, *System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide* Vol. 2: "Payment System" chapter

issues.title: Observability platform (capstone)
issues.goal: Design a multi-tenant metrics/logs/traces platform and compare it to how Grafana's stack solves it.
cover: Metrics / logs / traces ingestion at scale
Compare to how Loki / Mimir / Tempo solve it

resources.text: Grafana docs: [Loki](https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest/), [Mimir](https://grafana.com/docs/mimir/latest/), [Tempo](https://grafana.com/docs/tempo/latest/) (architecture sections)
